description:
This file defines the final class ValueConverter in the ScssPhp
amespace, handling parsing of SCSS values from strings and converting PHP values to SCSS-compatible values. It includes static methods for parsing and conversion, and references external classes such as Parser, Number, and Type.

classes.name: ValueConverter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse SCSS values from source strings and to convert PHP values into SCSS-compatible values.

methods.name: parseValue
methods.description: Parses a SCSS source string into a value supported by the compiler, throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: fromPhp
methods.description: Converts a PHP value to a Sass-compatible value, supporting numbers, null, booleans, strings, and arrays with specific types.
